info.name: Search for repositories

params.name: topic
params.description: Limit search to repositories with keyword as topic

params.name: includeDesc
params.description: include search of keyword within repository description

params.name: uid
params.description: search only for repos that the user with the given id owns or contributes to

params.name: priority_owner_id
params.description: repo owner to prioritize in the results

params.name: team_id
params.description: search only for repos that belong to the given team id

params.name: starredBy
params.description: search only for repos that the user with the given id has starred

params.name: private
params.description: include private repositories this user has access to (defaults to true)

params.name: is_private
params.description: show only public, private or all repositories (defaults to all)

params.name: template
params.description: include template repositories this user has access to (defaults to true)

params.name: archived
params.description: show only archived, non-archived or all repositories (defaults to all)

params.name: mode
params.description: type of repository to search for. Supported values are "fork", "source", "mirror" and "collaborative"

params.name: exclusive
params.description: if `uid` is given, search only for repos that the user owns

params.name: sort
params.description: sort repos by attribute. Supported values are "alpha", "created", "updated", "size", "git_size", "lfs_size", "stars", "forks" and "id". Default is "alpha"

params.name: order
params.description: sort order, either "asc" (ascending) or "desc" (descending). Default is "asc", ignored if "sort" is not specified.

params.name: page
params.description: page number of results to return (1-based)

items.docs: Search for repositories

params.name: attempt
params.description: 1-based attempt number matching the value of `attempt` in the job listing; omit to fetch the latest attempt of the job

info.name: List a repository's action runs

params.name: page
params.description: page number of results to return (1-based)

params.name: limit
params.description: page size of results, default maximum page size is 50

params.name: event
params.description: Returns workflow run triggered by the specified events. For example, `push`, `pull_request` or `workflow_dispatch`.

params.name: status
params.description: Returns workflow runs with the check run status or conclusion that is specified. For example, a conclusion can be success or a status can be in_progress. Only Forgejo Actions can set a status of waiting, pending, or requested.

params.name: run_number
params.description: Returns the workflow run associated with the run number.

params.name: head_sha
params.description: Only returns workflow runs that are associated with the specified head_sha.

params.name: ref
params.description: Only return workflow runs that involve the given Git reference, for example, `refs/heads/main`.

params.name: workflow_id
params.description: Only return workflow runs that involve the given workflow ID.

info.name: Download a ZIP of plaintext logs for every job in an action run

params.name: run_id
params.description: ID of the workflow run. The ZIP contains the latest attempt of each job in the run, with each entry named `{job-name}-{job-id}-attempt-{N}.log` (the job ID prevents collisions when two jobs share a name; the attempt number records which run the log came from). The run itself has no attempt number — jobs are re-run independently, so use the per-job logs endpoint with `?attempt` to fetch a specific historical attempt of one job.
